description: Move and resize windows to build a layout. Each item places one window: 'app' is the app name (fuzzy matched), optional 'title' filters windows of that app by title substring, optional 'screen' is the monitor index from get_state (each monitor can get its own layout — just send items with different 'screen' values; defaults to the screen the window is currently on), 'frame' is {x,y,w,h} as fractions 0..1 of that screen's visible area with origin at TOP-LEFT (left half = {x:0,y:0,w:0.5,h:1}; bottom-right quarter = {x:0.5,y:0.5,w:0.5,h:0.5}; centered 60% = {x:0.2,y:0.15,w:0.6,h:0.7}). Windows are unminimized if needed. Returns per-item success/errors.

app.description: App name to match, e.g. 'Safari', 'Visual Studio Code'

title.description: Only windows whose title contains this substring

name: apply_layout
